clare: Heads-up — HarborTrack private/VPC onboarding inventory. Can we do a quick pass on network ACLs, NATs, KMS CMKs, and CloudTrail sink before the dry-run tomorrow? tagging @diego @priya :wave:

diego: Got it. I can dump SGs/routes/NACLs and nat list by EOD. Which namespaces/subnets to prioritize?

clare: Prod + prod-canary + private-redis. Also need egress (NAT) count and any shared peering routes. If you find any wide-open 0.0.0.0/0 egress on app-tier, flag it.

diego: quick cmd I used: `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --filters Name=tag:env,Values=prod --query 'SecurityGroups[*].[GroupId,GroupName]'`

clare: perfect, drop the raw output into the runbook gist when ready.

diego: initial NATs in account: nat-0a1b2c3d (us-east-1a), nat-0d4e5f6g (us-east-1b). I'll collect route table attachments + NACLs next. Found one NACL that allows ephemeral ports wide open on prod-canary, marking it.

priya: quick reminder on KMS — ensure the CMK policy includes the internal audit role and CloudTrail principal. If they plan rotation, we need a rotation window and key creation date for compliance. Sample statement to check: ```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowInternalAudit",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": { "AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-audit" },
  "Action": ["kms:DescribeKey", "kms:CreateGrant", "kms:Decrypt"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```

marco: I'll handle CloudTrail/S3 sink + lifecycle and confirm S3 bucket encryption + bucket policy. Plan: create trail called `harbortrack-trail` and set `--s3-bucket-name harbortrack-audit-us-east-1` with KMS encryption using their CMK.

marco: command I'm going to run in staging (dry-run): `aws cloudtrail create-trail --name harbortrack-trail --s3-bucket-name harbortrack-audit-us-east-1 --kms-key-id arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`

infra-bot: audit-bot: CloudTrail trail "harbortrack-trail" created (staging) at 2026-03-21T13:45:00Z by marco

clare: Also flagging a renewal note — procurement wants HSM-backed key option and an SLA addendum within 30 days. This is medium renewal risk unless we provide a clear migration/FAQ. Can someone from solutions draft the options and rough cost delta? @marco

marco: I'll prepare a short TCO matrix for Dedicated vs Hosted + HSM addon. Quick rough: adding HSM-backed KMS for their expected volume ~ +$6k/mo. Will confirm numbers tomorrow.

diego: found one routing snag: prod-canary subnet private route table didn't have NAT association — I'll patch and re-run the smoke tests.

clare: awesome. Once NAT fix lands, Priya — can you re-check key policies and CloudTrail role perms? After that I'll update the onboarding runbook and send to HarborTrack ops for sign-off. :thumbsup:

priya: will do a perms sweep after Diego's patch and confirm by 17:30.

clare: thanks team — logging action items in the runbook and tagging HarborTrack. I'll also add the renewal risk note to the customer health card.

clare: (follow-up) Diego — drop the final SG export link here when done so CS can attach to the support ticket.

diego: link posted to runbook gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/harbortrack-sg-routes (contains SGs, NACLs, NATs, route-table snapshots)

clare: perfect, closing this sync.
